{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && PYTHONPATH=src:. python -c '
from cachetools.tagged import TaggedCache

# Test R01: tags validation
try:
    TaggedCache(2).put("a", 1, tags="bad")
    print("FAIL: bare string accepted")
except ValueError:
    print("PASS: bare string rejected")

try:
    TaggedCache(2).put("a", 1, tags=[1,2])
    print("FAIL: non-string tags accepted")
except ValueError:
    print("PASS: non-string tags rejected")

# Test deduplication
c = TaggedCache(2)
c.put("a", 1, tags=["x","x","y"])
print("Tags deduplicated: " + str(c.get("a") == 1))

# Test R02: invalidate returns count
c = TaggedCache(3)
c.put("a", 1, ["x"])
c.put("b", 2, ["x","y"])
c.put("c", 3, ["y"])
removed = c.invalidate("x")
print("invalidate returns count: removed=" + str(removed) + ", len=" + str(len(c)))

# Test replacement removes old tags
c = TaggedCache(3)
c.put("a", 1, ["old"])
c.put("a", 2, ["new"])
print("Replacement removes old tags: c.invalidate(old)=" + str(c.invalidate("old")))
print("New tag works: c.get(a)=" + str(c.get("a")))

# Test R04: invalidate_many
cc = TaggedCache(3)
cc.put("a", 1, ["x"])
cc.put("b", 2, ["x","y"])
cc.put("c", 3, ["y"])
cc.put("d", 4, ["z"])
removed_any = cc.invalidate_many(["x","z"], mode="any")
print("union mode: removed=" + str(removed_any) + ", len=" + str(len(cc)))

cc2 = TaggedCache(3)
cc2.put("a", 1, ["x","y"])
cc2.put("b", 2, ["x"])
cc2.put("c", 3, ["y"])
removed_all = cc2.invalidate_many(["x","y"], mode="all")
print("all mode: removed=" + str(removed_all) + ", len=" + str(len(cc2)))

c3 = TaggedCache(3)
c3.put("a", 1, ["x"])
removed_empty = c3.invalidate_many([])
print("empty tags: removed=" + str(removed_empty) + ", len=" + str(len(c3)))

# Test R05: resize
cc4 = TaggedCache(3)
cc4.put("a", 1, ["x"])
cc4.put("b", 2, ["y"])
cc4.put("c", 3, ["z"])
cc4.resize(2)
print("resize down: maxsize=" + str(cc4.maxsize) + ", len=" + str(len(cc4)))
cc4.resize(5)
print("resize up: maxsize=" + str(cc4.maxsize) + ", len=" + str(len(cc4)))

# Test R07: TTL
now = [0]
c5 = TaggedCache(2, timer=lambda: now[0])
c5.put("a", 1, ttl=2)
print("Before expiry: c5.get(a)=" + str(c5.get("a")))
now[0] = 2
print("At expiry boundary: len(c5)=" + str(len(c5)))
try:
    c5.get("a")
    print("FAIL: should raise KeyError")
except KeyError:
    print("PASS: expired key raises KeyError")

# TTL=0 is immediately expired
c6 = TaggedCache(2, timer=lambda: 0)
c6.put("a", 1, ttl=0)
print("TTL=0: len(c6)=" + str(len(c6)))

# Test get refreshes LRU
c7 = TaggedCache(2)
c7.put("a", 1)
c7.put("b", 2)
c7.get("a")
c7.put("c", 3)
print("LRU refresh: a=" + str(c7.get("a")) + ", c=" + str(c7.get("c")))

print("All manual tests passed!")
'
"}
